txt: *Too* late. You clearly have rigor mortis on your face, or wait... is that an *expression*? Are you trying to make an expression with that face? Why?
A mirror hangs above a bent and broken sink. In a fierce discharge of masculine energy someone has ripped half the faucet off.
A mirror hangs on the bathroom wall. In it -- your clean-shaven face, adorned with *The Expression*. You're still not accustomed to it.
A mirror hangs on the bathroom wall. In it -- your face, a regular, clean-shaven police officer.
A mirror hangs on the bathroom wall. In it -- your face, adorned with *The Expression*.
A mirror hangs on the bathroom wall. In it -- your face, now without *The Expression*. It's just hairy.
A mirror hangs on the bathroom wall. It's barely covered in steam anymore. It's your face in the mirror -- adorned with *The Expression*.
A mirror hangs on the bathroom wall. It's barely covered in steam anymore. You see your face, such as it is without *The Expression*. It's just hairy.
A mirror hangs on the bathroom wall. It's barely covered in steam anymore. You see your face, such as it is. A regular, clean-shaven police officer.
A mirror hangs on the bathroom wall. It's barely covered in steam anymore. You see yourself -- *The Expression* fixed to your clean-shaven face. You're still not accustomed to it.
A mirror hangs on the wall, covered in steam. You cannot see yourself, just the outlines of a man. You have no memory of the face that awaits you there, underneath the soft vapour.
An old mirror hangs on the wall, half-covered in shadows. You cannot see yourself fully, just the outline of a man. You have no memory of the face that awaits you there.
An old mirror hangs on the wall. You see the reflection of your face in it -- adorned with *The Expression*.
An old mirror hangs on the wall. You see the reflection of your face in it -- such as it is without *The Expression*. It's just hairy.
An old mirror hangs on the wall. You see the reflection of your face in it -- such as it is. A regular clean-shaven police officer.
An old mirror hangs on the wall. You see your reflection in it -- *The Expression* fixed to your clean-shaven face. You're still not accustomed to it.
As you slowly reach your hand toward the surface of the mirror...
Behold!

Bet you are. Your nose feels like a small balloon in the middle of your face. It hurts when you honk it, and it doesn't appear to be a particularly tiny nose either. Not with all the drinks it's *absorbed* for you.
Don't be scared. It's only your face. It's not like anyone is going to *see* it.
Getting clever appears to make *The Expression* even worse. Now it's mixed with smugness.
Good call. Go ahead and try something, if you like. Or -- you know -- stop staring into the mirror.
Hot water sprays from the base and steam covers the mirror. You cannot see yourself, just the outline of a man.
It appears you're also dead. There's clearly rigor mortis on your face, or wait... is that an *expression*? Are you trying to make an expression with that face? Why?
It doesn't have to be. You can swoon over Guillaume and his champagne-cork smile whenever you want to... Maybe some of the stardust will return?
It's not. It's swollen and snail-like, wriggling between your fingers.
Maybe that's how it started? And now it doesn't even matter anymore -- you've worn that grin into your face and it will never come *off*...
No. That would be too insane.
Oh my god, you *can't* stop! It's like it's not even voluntary anymore! You have worn that grin into your face and now it won't come off...
Oh my god, you're right! It's like it's not even voluntary anymore. You have worn that grin into your face and now it won't come *off*...
Please promise yourself you are not going to try it on any of the *ladies*, whatever happens.
Please stop, it's horrible! You're scaring yourself.

Really -- all recollection of the person you are, the people in your life and even the world you're in has drowned in a sea of blood alcohol. This was no mere night of drinking, it was a deluge. Of world-ending proportions.
Suddenly you realise you have no memory of the face that awaits you there, underneath the soft vapour.
That's right! Not even yourself. Go ahead, try something, it's not an order.
The bathroom mirror has been wiped completely clean. You see the reflection of your face in the mirror -- even now adorned with *The Expression*.
The bathroom mirror has been wiped completely clean. You see the reflection of your face in the mirror -- such as it is without *The Expression*. It's just hairy.
The bathroom mirror has been wiped completely clean. You see the reflection of your face in the mirror -- such as it is. A regular, clean-shaven police officer.
The bathroom mirror has been wiped completely clean. You see the reflection of yourself in the mirror -- *The Expression* fixed to your clean-shaven face. You're still not accustomed to it.
The mirror begins to clear slowly without you having to wipe it.
There might have been. Ten years ago. It's little more than a cadaverous spasm now.
What does it even *mean*? What is the emotion you're trying to convey?
Whatever it is, at least it's dead now. There's clearly rigor mortis on your face. Or wait... is that an *expression*? Are you trying to make an expression with that face?
Where to even begin? There's the bloatedness, then the swollenness... It's like there's an upholstery of alcohol underneath your skin.
Yeah, there is definitely something wrong with it.
You *can't*, can you? It's like it's not even voluntary anymore. You have worn that grin into your face and now it won't come *off*...
You are correct.
You find no sign of life on your swollen neck. However, putting your hand on your chest reveals an irregular heartbeat. You appear to be alive -- for now.
You have no idea who this *thing* is, do you?
You liar. You can't even tell the truth to yourself. Go ahead, try something!
You should check yourself for a pulse, because from here it looks like a cadaverous spasm.
You should check yourself for a pulse, superstar. From here it looks like a cadaverous spasm.
You step back from the mirror. A bead of water drips from the pipe beneath the washbasin.
You step back from the mirror. A loose board creaks.
